# Laravel Customer Support Chat + Posts Forum

- [x] Verify project requirements are clear

- [x] Install required dependencies

## Project Overview

A Laravel-based customer support application featuring:

- Real-time customer support chat system
- Community posts/forum system
- User authentication and authorization
- Database migrations for all features
- RESTful API endpoints

## Key Features

1. **Chat System**: Real-time messaging between customers and support staff
2. **Forum/Posts**: Discussion forum for community posts with comments
3. **User Management**: Customer and staff role differentiation
4. **Responsive UI**: Bootstrap-based frontend
